capabilities.name: super_engines.design_inference_loop
capabilities.description: Execute the AMOS Super Engines governed perception-belief-action loop with evidence, uncertainty, authority, and safety bounds.

capabilities.name: super_engines.validate_governance
capabilities.description: Validate AMOS Super Engines outputs against governance gates: constraint, authority, safety, policy, scope, evidence, reversibility.

capabilities.name: super_engines.analyze_belief_state
capabilities.description: Analyze AMOS Super Engines belief state: competing hypotheses, uncertainty vector, prediction error, and evidence basis.

capabilities.name: super_engines.trace_inference_provenance
capabilities.description: Trace AMOS Super Engines outputs to observations, evidence, prediction model, and RSCF provenance chain.

capabilities.name: super_engines.assess_inference_claim
capabilities.description: Assess AMOS Super Engines claims for epistemic class (AMOS_MODEL not BIOLOGICAL_PROOF), evidence strength, and falsifier availability.

capabilities.name: super_engines.manage_loop_lifecycle
capabilities.description: Manage AMOS Super Engines loop lifecycle: observe, infer, compare, generate, govern, select, act, measure, update, stop.

capabilities.name: super_engines.detect_loop_drift
capabilities.description: Detect inference drift: goal drift, authority drift, proxy optimization, confirmation loop, and belief overconfidence.

capabilities.name: super_engines.escalate_inference_gaps
capabilities.description: Escalate AMOS Super Engines gaps: FREEZE on unresolved validation, preserve competing hypotheses, trigger discriminating evidence.

capabilities.name: super_engines.manage_lifecycle
capabilities.description: Manage lifecycle: classify, validate, trace, assess, detect.

capabilities.name: super_engines.detect_drift
capabilities.description: Detect drift in evidence chains, provenance freshness, or confidence calibration.

capabilities.name: super_engines.validate_outputs
capabilities.description: Validate outputs against domain constraints and epistemic class.

operations.action: ORIENT: Identify the problem and confirm it matches the super engines scope.
CLASSIFY: Classify the query against super engines sub-capabilities and frameworks.
APPLY: Apply the appropriate super engines framework with epistemic class labeling.
CHALLENGE: Challenge results against epistemic firewall and domain-specific invariants.
SYNTHESIZE: Synthesize results with provenance and confidence ceiling.

integrity_requirements: SUPER ENGINES model != empirical proof: framework is not empirical validation
Structural mapping != causal proof: mapping is not causation
Capability != Authority: having a capability does not authorize its use
Competing hypotheses must be preserved under uncertainty
Fail closed on UNKNOWN/GAP: do not fabricate to remove placeholders
safety_constraints: No claim beyond established evidence or explicitly labeled AMOS_MODEL
Fail closed on UNKNOWN/GAP: do not fabricate to remove placeholders
